## Featured research

### Nothing to Lose

A study of voting eligibility and political attitudes among German teenagers. I compare those who lost the vote with those who had never held it to examine withdrawal and exclusion.

[Read the paper](research/nothing-to-lose.html) · [View the presentation](research/nothing-to-lose-slides.html)
